title: Тайник Сени и предложение без пирожного  (Senya's Hiding Spot and a Proposal Without Pastry)

segments.t: In the climax of the flashback, while Louis stalls for ten more minutes, Chef Barinov and Nagiyev realize they will have to manage the evening without any pastries at all. Back in the present, Barinov reflects on how Senya's habit of stealing food nearly derailed the owner's engagement.
И потом у него есть тайное место.
Давайте в ваше кольцо я спрячу его пирожное.
Right, let's take their exchange slowly and unpack the Russian.
'Well, what is going on in here?' Wondering what going on in here is cuts straight through the tension between Louis and Max.
'Where is the dessert?' Asking where the dessert is is how Max puts Louis on the spot. In Russian, he does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.

'Louis, where is the dessert?' Here asking where the dessert is shows Louis looking for the real truth. In Russian, he does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.
'We just need to wait a little bit longer.' Around the plan and point, Max sets a calm, everyday tone with Louis.

'Where is the ring?' Asking where the ring is cuts straight through the tension between Louis and Max. In Russian, he does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.
'Vitya, what on earth is that?' Asking whether what on earth is puts Louis right on the defensive. Russian drops "is" in the present, setting the two halves of the thought side by side.
'It is much safer this way.' Even though it is much safer this way, Louis keeps a steady face in front of Max.
'Look how big that guy is.' Admitting that how big that guy is shows Max being honest for a change.
И потом у него есть тайное место.

'And besides, he has a secret hiding spot.' Saying that besides he has a secret hiding spot is how Louis sets the tone with Max. In Russian you say "by me" or "with us" rather than "I have", so the situation sits right with the person.
Давайте в ваше кольцо я спрячу его пирожное.
'Let me hide your ring inside a pastry for him.' Telling Louis to let him hide Louis's ring inside a pastry for him is how Max lays out the situation for Louis.
'It will take about ten minutes.' Adding that it will take about ten minutes fills in the missing piece for Max. Russian drops "is" in the present, setting the two halves of the thought side by side.
'Right now, coming right up.' Between the room and the plan, Max gives Louis a quick, grounded response.

'We will manage without pastries from now on.' Since they will manage without pastries from now, Louis does not waste words on excuses. Now let's listen to the entire scene again without interruption.
И потом у него есть тайное место.
Давайте в ваше кольцо я спрячу его пирожное.

That wraps up this scene as while the flashback shows Nagiyev giving up on the pastry, in the present Chef Barinov tells Lyova how that disaster paradoxically failed to stop Nagiyev from marrying Kristina. Until next time!
